title: Lentil Bolognese
shortDescription: Plant-forward ragu with green lentils, cremini, and whole-wheat pasta
subtitle: Plant-forward ragu with green lentils, cremini, and whole-wheat pasta
description: Green lentils and finely chopped mushrooms simmer with tomato, wine, and herbs into a rich bolognese served over whole-wheat spaghetti.

steps.title: Cook lentils
steps.instruction: Simmer lentils in broth 20–25 minutes until tender but holding shape. Drain excess liquid so sauce does not turn watery.

steps.title: Brown mushrooms
steps.instruction: Cook mushrooms in olive oil over high heat in batches 8–10 minutes until deeply browned and moisture evaporates, not gray and wet.

steps.title: Build soffritto base
steps.instruction: Sauté onion, carrot, celery 8 minutes until softened. Add garlic and tomato paste, cook 2 minutes until paste darkens to brick red.

steps.title: Simmer ragu
steps.instruction: Add wine, reduce 3 minutes. Add crushed tomatoes and cooked lentils. Simmer 20 minutes uncovered until thick and spoon-coating.

steps.title: Toss with pasta
steps.instruction: Boil spaghetti al dente, drain, toss with ragu. Sauce should cling to noodles with visible mushroom and lentil pieces throughout.

proTips: A parmesan rind simmered in sauce adds umami without meat.
Offer grated parmesan at the line for crew who want extra richness.
Sauce freezes well—thaw and toss with fresh pasta.
leftovers: Bolognese baked ziti with mozzarella top.
Lasagna layers with ricotta and sauce.
whyCrewsLikeIt: Meaty texture without meat. Budget-friendly and fiber-rich for crews trying to eat more plants.
mealPrepNotes: Pulse mushrooms in food processor for fine crumb texture. Cook lentils separately if using pre-cooked. Station: Brown mushrooms in batches—crowded mushrooms steam instead of caramelize. Station: Simmer sauce wide and uncovered so it reduces to thick ragu consistency. Station: Toss pasta with sauce in largest pot or baking dish for even coating.

adaptable.label: Gluten-Free Adaptable
adaptable.note: Use a certified gluten-free pasta. Use a certified gluten-free broth or bouillon.

adaptable.label: Alcohol-Free Adaptable
adaptable.note: Substitute broth plus a splash of vinegar for the acidity.
